title: Optimized peptide extraction method for analysis of antimicrobial peptide Kn2-7/dKn2-7 stability in human serum by LC-MS. Future Sci OA.
summary: Source-reviewed rework extracted the local LC-MS recovery and serum-stability values, preserved DRAMP activity/modification conflicts, and removed framework placeholder mechanism notes.
adjudication_summary: The paper is publication-grade for obtainable local material with cautions: it supports LC-MS recovery/stability curation for Kn2-7/dKn2-7 but does not report primary MIC, organism-killing, hemolysis, or cytotoxicity assays.

materials_exhausted.note: Source package has no supplementary assets/tables; this is an exhausted absence, not an open material request.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material remains separate as material_extracted_with_gaps because no supplementary assets/tables are present, while XML/PDF/OA/database surfaces needed for this re-review were exhausted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Required final JSON structures, locators, source-reviewed provenance, and status vocabularies are present.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DRAMP literature linkage is source-verified; DRAMP activity/modification rows are preserved as source_conflict rather than promoted beyond the primary paper.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Ten source-supported LC-MS recovery/stability rows were extracted; no MIC/MBC/hemolysis/cytotoxicity rows are inferred.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Only indirect pharmacostability and analytical-method context are retained; no direct antimicrobial mechanism is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: All open rework reasons from the handoff were checked and either resolved or preserved as nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary paper reports LC-MS recovery and serum stability, not MIC/MBC/hemolysis/cytotoxicity values.
DRAMP activity labels are retained as database provenance but conflict with the lack of primary antimicrobial assay rows in this paper.
Primary source supports dKn2-7 as a D-isomer; local text does not explicitly recover every DRAMP modification annotation.
Packet and source supplementary inventories are empty; no spreadsheet/office/archive supplement remains to parse.
